not_yet_extractable.ABORT_LC: needs a lane change BEGUN and then abandoned — a two-phase lateral signature we do not yet detect, and rare enough that no calibration reference exists in the corpus.
not_yet_extractable.YIELD_MERGE: needs MERGE (a perception claim) to coincide with a measured deceleration. MERGE itself now stands at 82 clips after the hazard guard, so the joint event is too rare to calibrate.
